summary: Neo-Concept International Group Holdings filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at its October 29, 2026 Extraordinary General Meeting of a share consolidation (a reverse share split, the non-US equivalent of a US reverse stock split) ranging from 2-for-1 to 400-for-1, plus a standing two-year authority for further consolidations capped at 500-to-1 in aggregate. The board set the ratio at 8-to-1 (par US$0.0025 to US$0.02), effective at Nasdaq open November 10, 2026, cutting 8,481,952 ordinary shares to roughly 1,060,246, trading as NCI under new CUSIP G6421C146. This is a routine capital-structure action, not a special situation; watch fractional-share rounding and any follow-on reverse splits.
